# AI product strategy and metrics

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/ai-product-strategy.md) · [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md) › [Themes](../README.md#themes)

When AI is worth it, how to design AI features, measure them and build the business case.

## <a id="track-leadership"></a>AI Leadership

- <a id="prod-enterprise-assistant"></a>**How would you improve ChatGPT for enterprise customers?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-enterprise-assistant) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-enterprise-assistant&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-enterprise-assistant)
  - Tests: Whether you select a specific workflow and justify its business value.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Choose a customer segment, user and costly workflow problem.
    - Compare AI and non-AI solutions, integration effort and trust requirements.
    - Define a pilot outcome, quality guardrails and a rollout decision.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research) · [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers)
- <a id="prod-capability-cost"></a>**A model offers much greater capability but costs ten times as much. How would you decide what product to build with it?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-capability-cost) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-capability-cost&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-capability-cost)
  - Tests: Whether you translate capability into willingness to pay and unit economics.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Identify tasks where the improvement changes the feasible outcome.
    - Estimate cost per successful workflow, including retries and human review.
    - Test willingness to pay and consider selective routing before broad deployment.
  - Read: [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers) · [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
- <a id="prod-ai-suitability"></a>**How do you decide whether an LLM is useful for a proposed product problem?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Google and Google DeepMind](../companies/google.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-ai-suitability) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-ai-suitability&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-ai-suitability)
  - Tests: Whether you start with the task and evidence rather than the technology.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Describe the job, baseline solution and cost of mistakes.
    - Check data access, evaluability, latency and the need for predictable behaviour.
    - Run a bounded comparison and name a reason to reject the LLM approach.
  - Read: [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers) · [Building Effective AI Agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) (Anthropic)
- <a id="prod-student-assistant"></a>**Design a Gemini-based assistant for university students.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Google and Google DeepMind](../companies/google.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-student-assistant) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-student-assistant&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-student-assistant)
  - Tests: Whether a clear user need drives scope, learning outcomes and safeguards.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Pick a student segment and one recurring unmet need.
    - Design a usable flow with uncertainty, verification and misuse in mind.
    - Measure task success and learning value alongside retention.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research) · [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST)
- <a id="prod-confident-errors"></a>**Users say Gemini gives incorrect answers with excessive confidence. What would you change?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Google and Google DeepMind](../companies/google.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-confident-errors) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-confident-errors&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-confident-errors)
  - Tests: Whether you diagnose failure types and improve calibrated user trust.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Collect representative failures and separate knowledge, retrieval and presentation issues.
    - Compare grounding, abstention and interaction changes on the same tasks.
    - Track unsupported claims, useful task completion and segment-level regressions.
  - Read: [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST) · [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- <a id="prod-writing-priorities"></a>**How would you prioritise features for an AI writing assistant in Microsoft Word?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-writing-priorities) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-writing-priorities&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-writing-priorities)
  - Tests: Whether prioritisation accounts for user value, reliability and workflow fit.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Segment writing tasks and identify friction in the existing workflow.
    - Compare expected value, quality risk, engineering cost and dependencies.
    - Choose a narrow first release and measure accepted, useful assistance.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research) · [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers)
- <a id="prod-ai-feature-metrics"></a>**How would you measure success for an AI feature in a Microsoft product?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-ai-feature-metrics) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-ai-feature-metrics&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-ai-feature-metrics)
  - Tests: Whether metrics connect model behaviour to user and business outcomes.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Name the user goal and an observable successful task.
    - Separate adoption, retention, task quality, latency and cost.
    - Use a baseline or experiment and guard against metric gaming.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
- <a id="prod-search-north-star"></a>**What North Star metric would you choose for an AI search product, and what would constrain it?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-search-north-star) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-search-north-star&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-search-north-star)
  - Tests: Whether one headline metric remains accountable to trust and task completion.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Define a valuable completed search task and how to observe it.
    - Add quality, safety, latency and cost guardrails.
    - Explain denominator, segmentation and how the metric could mislead.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
- <a id="prod-notification-paradox"></a>**Notification engagement rises while total time spent remains flat. How would you interpret that result?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) 🗣 · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-notification-paradox) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-notification-paradox&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-notification-paradox)
  - Tests: Whether you distinguish substitution, measurement artifacts and real user value.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Check definitions, exposure, cohorts and the experiment setup.
    - Test whether notifications shift existing activity or create valuable new actions.
    - Include opt-outs, satisfaction and longer-term effects before deciding.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
- <a id="prod-favorite-agent"></a>**Choose an AI agent or product you use and propose its most valuable improvement.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#prod-favorite-agent) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-favorite-agent&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-favorite-agent)
  - Tests: Whether product judgement rests on observed friction and a testable hypothesis.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Describe a real workflow and where the product fails the user.
    - Explain why the proposed improvement outranks alternatives.
    - Specify a prototype, success measure and possible adverse effect.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
- <a id="prod-memory-machine-launch"></a>**You have invented a memory machine that generates video, images, smells and sounds. How would you bring it to market?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) † · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-memory-machine-launch&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-memory-machine-launch)
  - Tests: Whether you turn an unfamiliar capability into a focused market entry.
- <a id="prod-agent-use-cases"></a>**Which business use cases suit AI agents, and how would you compare them?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) † · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-agent-use-cases&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-agent-use-cases)
  - Tests: Whether you distinguish the value of autonomous action from its operational cost.
- <a id="prod-model-choice"></a>**Explain the product trade-offs in choosing a model.**
  - Knowledge · Senior · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) † · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-model-choice&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-model-choice)
  - Tests: Whether model selection considers task quality, cost, latency and constraints together.
- <a id="prod-new-search-feature"></a>**Propose a new feature for Perplexity and explain whom it serves.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) † · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-new-search-feature&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-new-search-feature)
  - Tests: Whether you can make a differentiated, evidence-seeking product proposal.
- <a id="prod-roadmap"></a>**How do you prioritise a product roadmap when several valuable opportunities compete?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) † · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-roadmap&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-roadmap)
  - Tests: Whether prioritisation exposes assumptions and opportunity cost.
- <a id="prod-handyman-marketplace"></a>**Design a product connecting local tradespeople with customers.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) 🗣 · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-handyman-marketplace&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-handyman-marketplace)
  - Tests: Whether you reason about both sides of a marketplace and initial liquidity.
- <a id="prod-product-cannibalisation"></a>**A new service grows while Facebook monthly active users decline. How would you assess whether the service is succeeding?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) 🗣 · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-product-cannibalisation&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-product-cannibalisation)
  - Tests: Whether you investigate portfolio effects instead of reading one metric in isolation.
- <a id="prod-volunteer-cold-start"></a>**Design a volunteer-matching product and explain how it gets through cold start.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) 🗣 · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=prod-volunteer-cold-start&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20prod-volunteer-cold-start)

- <a id="prod-search-versus-answer"></a>**Where does an AI answer engine outperform traditional search, and where does it fall short? What would you improve first?**

  - Tests: Whether you compare products through user tasks and evidence quality.
